help:
filer: Create, edit, and list files.

Subcommands:
  filer create — Create a file.
  filer edit — Replace text in a file.
  filer measure — Record readings.
  filer forward — Forward argv.
  filer status — Set a status.
  filer list — List files.
  filer watch — Background pollers.

filer create: Create a file.

Usage:

  filer create <path> <<'EOF'
  <content>
  EOF
    Parameters:
      <path> (required)
    Stdin body: content - File content

filer edit: Replace text in a file.

Usage:

  filer edit <path> --old <old> --new <new> [--occurrence <occurrence>]
    Parameters:
      <path> (required)
      --old <old> (required)
      --new <new> (required)
      --occurrence <occurrence> (optional)

filer measure: Record readings.

Usage:

  filer measure --v <v> [--label <label>] [--quiet [true|false]]
    Parameters:
      --v <v> (required, repeatable)
      --label <label> (optional, repeatable)
      --quiet [true|false] (optional)

filer forward: Forward argv.

Usage:

  filer forward -- <args>...
    Parameters:
      -- <args>... (required)

filer status: Set a status.

Usage:

  filer status [--status <pending|in_progress|done>]
    Parameters:
      --status <pending|in_progress|done> (optional)

filer list: List files.

Usage:

  filer list [--json]
    Success output: raw text by default; machine-readable JSON when --json is passed
    --json: emits machine-readable JSON for this command

filer watch: Background pollers.

Subcommands:
  filer watch get — Read a poller.

filer watch get: Read a poller.

Usage:

  filer watch get <id>
    Parameters:
      <id> (required)

kcenv: Read an environment key.

Usage:

  kcenv <key>
    Parameters:
      <key> (required)
